initialization_rule: For every sequence-local GT person, the first annotated frame satisfying class 1, confidence >0, width>=16, height>=32, area>=1024 and visibility>=0.5; no performance-based selection. Crop the actual image once for an immutable OSNet anchor. Runtime receives only the anchor, initial box, frame and anonymous token, never the GT identity.
candidate_source: Existing real SAM3/OSNet N72R20R2 frozen GT-free tape; no candidate axis changes
runtime_schema: Typed Candidate values contain only UID, current embedding, current predicted box, quality and scoped native tracklet ID.
primary_candidate_truth: Post-runtime one-to-one current-frame candidate/GT IoU matching >=0.5; unmatched means invalid/unresolved, not proven other physical identity.
target_recall_truth: Selected box IoU>=0.5 with current target GT; report all-visible denominator separately from strict candidate-available denominator.
absence_semantics: Complete visible-person annotations with target unannotated. Do not infer physical out-of-view versus full occlusion without further evidence. Sparse TAO subsets cannot label unannotated frames as true absence.
fps: Read actual seqinfo.ini; no concatenated frame gaps across recordings
